text:
Ivy (Sales): Ochre sent an RFP. Must-haves: private VPC, HSM BYOK (Thales called out), EU data residency, 180d audit retention, POC for embeddings+chat, and a capability matrix + tiered pricing. RFI attached.

Elliot (Ochre): Hi team 9 quick numbers: steady 140 QPS embeddings, spikes to 420 overnight. Target embed dim 512, latency P95 <110ms. Need evidence of HSM key import and audit trail.

Rahul (Solutions): Proposed POC: private cluster in eu-west-1 with VPC peering, HSM BYOK demo using Thales emulator, perf runs at 100/140/420 QPS, fidelity evals on their corpus, SIEM export test. Prep ~7 days, run 4 days.

Maya (Security): I'll take RFI sections for crypto, key rotation, logging. Note: exporting token contents requires DPA addendum. We'll provide pen-test summary and SOC2 snapshot.

Cora (Product): Model guidance: embed-512-int8 for latency/cost and embed-512-fp16 for fidelity. For chat use a latency-optimized int8 variant. I'll add a column for expected recall@k and latency.

Rahul (Solutions): POC infra snippet for infra:

```
redwood_poc:
  region: eu-west-1
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: true
  nodes: 6
  node_type: a2
  embed_dim: 512
  quant_profile: int8
  kms: thales-emulator
```

Ivy (Sales): Elliot 12 can you confirm if Ochre needs subcontractor lists and whether 180d retention is firm? Also any budget targets?

Elliot (Ochre): Subcontractor list: limited disclosure OK under NDA. Retention: 180 days is firm. Budget: aiming to compare reserved 12mo vs burst; need rough quotes.

Sam (Legal): If we disclose subcontractor lists we need an NDA addendum. Token-level content export triggers DPA and SOW review. I'll draft the templates.

Maya (Security): Uploading attachments we'll share: "soc2_snapshot.pdf", "pen-test-2025.pdf", "thales_hsm_note.pdf", "audit_export_playbook.pdf". We'll redact PII in any telemetry exports.

Rahul (Solutions): Pricing sketch: Reserved cluster for 140 QPS + buffer estimated at $YYk/mo; 12mo commit discounts; burst per-token for spikes. I'll produce three scenarios and add to the quote.

Ivy (Sales): Next steps: Rahul -> finalize POC runbook + perf matrix + pricing scenarios; Maya -> RFI answers + attachments; Cora -> capability matrix with model guidance; Sam -> NDA/DPA templates. I'll assemble and send Ochre packet by EOD Friday.

ci-bot: Branch "ochre-rfp" infra lint OK, CI tests passed.

Elliot (Ochre): Thanks all 9 we'll review packet and propose POC dates.

Ivy (Sales): Great, keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
